instruction: A candid documentary wide shot at eye-level captures an indoor studio with a red carpet and white pillars. On the right side, the bearded man in a black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, smiling as he reaches out to touch the face of the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) with his right hand. The woman (R2) stands on the center-left with her back to the camera, facing the man. In the background, dark partitions and storage shelves are visible. The setting is evenly lit by overhead lights, highlighting the warm tones of the red carpet floor.
elements: R1 reaches out with his right hand to touch R2's face
R2 is the person whose face is being touched by R1
R1 stands facing R2 while initiating the face-touch contact
R2 stands with her back to the camera while facing R1
The interaction takes place in an indoor studio with a red carpet and white pillars
